source.title: Huff, F.A., 1990. Time Distributions of Heavy Rainstorms in Illinois. Illinois State Water Survey Circular 173. Table 3, Median Time Distributions of Heavy Storm Rainfall at a Point, third-quartile column (printed page 14).

notes: Transcribed from the scanned table (no text layer). A 100-min storm makes minutes equal percent of storm time. The table prints 5 to 95 %; 0 and 100 % are definitional. Legacy curve: ISWS Bulletin 75 supersedes the Circular 173 / Bulletin 71 time distributions. Not printed in the Hydraflow manual, so Hydraflow equivalence is open.
